limits: Finite-case and bounded-reader evidence, not universal stability/security certification.
Native Rust memory is the documented smaller profile; Python owns the functional NPC and broader memory/generation APIs.
Minecraft results cover a controlled delayed-cue task on pinned 1.21.1/Fabric. Paths retain backtracking; no optimal navigation or arbitrary-game transfer claim.
The NPC has no fixed well/action-count or episode cap; lookup/storage grow with experience and existing numeric/snapshot bounds remain explicit.
The maintained GPU fitter is measured on one adapter; historical fused kernels, full external-corpus/model campaigns and unrelated Java/Dart host applications were not rerun.
No consumer migrated, production world touched or registry release published.
UCI HAR measures supervised representation readout, not NPC action learning. Simple window moments outperform the oscillator-only and combined features in the retained comparison.

Affine analysis has explicit intercept/origin state outside V4. Its real-signal forecasting follow-up reuses an inspected benchmark; the original homogeneous fit wins mean and median error. Existing NPC policy and game sources remain unchanged.

History concat preserves fitting evidence, not online policy training. Two-scale observer proofs cover a declared 64-state sliding-window table, not the unbounded floating NPC. Strict Schur blends do not certify arbitrary switching or bounded transient gain.

hosted_ci.scope: Historical hosted run with no executed steps, not a validation of the public source snapshot. Locally executed checks and platform scope are recorded separately.

hardening.mathematical_contracts: Unified coordinate, lag-moment, regularized-fit, affine-origin, well, relational-view and composition documentation. Coefficient averages remain distinct from pooled least squares.
numeric_fixes: Power-of-two-scaled quadratic extraction preserves small roots and rejects unrepresentable output.
Component-scaled complex cosine avoids norm overflow and underflow.
Spectral diagnostics avoid coefficient squaring and scale magnitude summaries.
Real sample boundaries reject complex arrays without truncating imaginary coordinates.
Relational checkpoint PSD, rank and symmetry checks are scale-normalized; one-sample scatter is exactly zero.
Weighted centered-moment merging avoids an overflowing unweighted outer product.
hardening.documentation: Maintained overviews and reference pages describe contracts and evidence domains; source lineage is separated from implementation instructions. Local file and heading targets are checked.
hardening.source_bound_receipts: Existing stress, real-data, affine, history, projection and relational protocols re-executed with unchanged configuration. Measured task results and all three retained native semantic traces match the reference.
hardening.scope: Local Windows verification, installed-wheel tests, browser workflows, real-device GPU comparison and native Minecraft fixtures. No additional novelty claim or consumer migration.
